rationale: MEOH gapped up ~6.7% on a strong earnings beat and is trading at 45.5% of today's range with price below VWAP ($67.55) and below the session high ($69.03), suggesting the initial gap momentum has faded and the stock is in a choppy consolidation. The risk/reward in either direction is unclear enough to warrant sitting out this cycle.
